## Portfolio Projects

### AIVIZED Agent Factory
AI + No-Code platform for creating chatbots without coding. Backend: Python 3.11.8, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0, PostgreSQL (Neon), OpenAI GPT-4o, cryptography (Fernet), structlog, httpx. Frontend Widget: React 18, TypeScript, Vite 5 IIFE bundle. Admin Dashboard: Next.js 14+, TailwindCSS, Prisma, JWT auth. Infrastructure: PostgreSQL 15+ on Neon, Docker, Railway, OpenAPI 3.0/3.1.
- Deploy production-ready AI chatbots in under 10 minutes
- No-code configuration & deployment
- Self-contained widget bundling

### Instagram Growth OS — Grow with Meta Verified APIs
AI + Social platform connecting to Instagram via Meta Graph API v25.0. Tech: TypeScript, Next.js 16.1.6 (App Router), React 19.2.3, Tailwind CSS v4, Clerk auth, OpenAI SDK v6.29.0 (gpt-4o-mini), Recharts v3.8, Zustand v5, Stripe.js. Deployment: Vercel. Zero database — all data in Clerk metadata, generated dynamically via OpenAI.
- Hook analysis, caption generation, reel scripts
- Content scoring & comment intelligence
- Competitor gap analysis & niche trend tracking
- Story planning & post scheduling

### FiveOS — Fiverr Growth using AI
AI + Market Intelligence tool. Languages: TypeScript, Python 3.11, GLSL, CSS. Frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS 3, lucide-react, react-markdown, ogl (WebGL/3D). Backend: FastAPI + Uvicorn, OpenAI API (o3-mini + gpt-4o), curl_cffi (Cloudflare bypass), BeautifulSoup4 + lxml. Real-time Fiverr market analysis with streaming UI.
- Real-time Fiverr scraping via curl_cffi
- Multi-model AI (o3-mini + gpt-4o) deep strategy reasoning
- WebGL shader background with streaming strategy output

### Talent AI — Smart Job & Candidate Matching
AI + HR Tech platform. Languages: TypeScript. Frontend: React 19, Vite 6, React Router DOM v7, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui (base-nova), Base UI React, Lucide React, Motion (Framer Motion), class-variance-authority, clsx, tailwind-merge, Sonner, date-fns. Backend: Express, tsx, dotenv. AI: Google Gen AI SDK (Gemini API). Data: pdfjs-dist (PDF), mammoth (DOCX). Database & Auth: Firebase v12 (Firestore, Auth, Storage).
- AI-powered CV scoring against job requirements
- Auto-shortlisting based on ATS compatibility
- Custom job application forms with shareable links
- Detailed scoring & reasoning per submission

### VideoDown — YouTube, Instagram & TikTok Downloader
Tool. Languages: TypeScript, CSS. Framework: Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18. Styling: Tailwind CSS 3, PostCSS, Autoprefixer. Libraries: youtube-dl-exec, ffmpeg-static, rate-limiter-flexible. Cross-platform video/audio downloader.
- Cross-platform downloads (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram)
- Video + MP3 audio extraction via ffmpeg
- Rate-limited API

### AI Lead Engine — Automated Outreach System
AI + Automation multi-agent system. Tech: TypeScript, Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, BullMQ, Redis, Playwright, Cheerio, OpenAI SDK, Nodemailer, NextAuth.js, Zustand, Zod, Docker, Radix UI, Recharts. Four agents: Alex (Lead Collector via Google Maps scraping + social activity check), Sarah (Lead Verifier for SEO/speed/chatbot readiness), Marcus (Email Outreach via OpenAI + SMTP/Gmail), Chloe (Social Outreach — Instagram/LinkedIn DMs, in progress).
- 100 leads analyzed per job
- Automated SEO/speed/chatbot verification
- Personalized email generation via OpenAI
